softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
Leveraging the rich visualization capabilities of Power BI, we designed a dashboard tailored for display on large LED screens in the offices of senior court officials. The dashboard depicts the real-time status of cases, current caseload volume, and efficiency-linked Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


The interface is designed to be self-updating at periodic intervals, ensuring that officials always have the latest operational data. This solution provides an attractive, high-visibility way for senior leadership to track the efficiency of court operations and share critical metrics with key stakeholders at a glance.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: A court authority within the Dubai jurisdiction (DIFC).
softwarePortfolioLayout.testimonialContent: The Power BI dashboard is excellent for our office displays. It provides our senior officials with an immediate, clear overview of case status and operational efficiency in a very visually engaging format.
